user_query: I want to plan a Fortnite-themed game night with my friends and need to search for Fortnite skins, check the Steam Community group for announcements, and fetch my alias history.

TaskList.description: Search for available Fortnite skins and compile a list of options.
Fetch the profile of the Steam Community group 'l4d' to check for announcements or comments related to Fortnite.
Retrieve a list of user aliases along with the dates they were changed using the User Aliases API.
